name: Anisotropic Neural Representation Learning
definition: A method that models volumetric density and latent features as view-dependent functions using spherical harmonics (SH) to eliminate directional ambiguity in neural rendering, replacing the isotropic point-sampled features of standard NeRF.
summary: Anisotropic Neural Representation Learning is a NeRF method using spherical harmonics to model view-dependent features, eliminating directional ambiguity and replacing isotropic point-sampled features.
